name: How much does an outdoor living project cost in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How much does an outdoor living project cost in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an outdoor living project in the Las Vegas area varies significantly based on its scope, materials selected, and features included. A basic patio might start at a few thousand dollars, while a comprehensive outdoor kitchen, custom pool deck, or elaborate landscaping design could range from tens of thousands to over a hundred thousand dollars. Factors like permits, site preparation, and utility extensions also influence the final investment. It's best to discuss your vision for a tailored estimate.
